editorial.verdict: A spec-led pick for hemming knits: three coverstitch widths, a free arm and 0.5 to 2.25 differential feed, with a thin owner record behind it.
editorial.whoFor: A garment sewist who hems knits often and wants a dedicated coverstitch with a published 4 x 5.5 in bed space and a tension release lever.
editorial.skipIf: You want a built-in top cover stitch (a 3000 Professional feature) or a cheaper coverstitch where the Brother 2340CV covers the job.
editorial.keySpec: 1/2/3 needle · 3 or 6 mm cover · 4 x 5.5 in bed space (maker wording) · 1,000 spm

faqs.q: What is the difference between the 1000CPX, 2000CPX and 3000 Professional?
faqs.a: Per Janome's pages the MSRPs are $999, $1,099 and $1,799. The 1000CPX page lists Seam Tightening System and no TLC; the 3000 Professional adds a built-in top cover stitch and needle threader.

faqs.q: Can the 2000CPX do a top cover stitch?
faqs.a: No. Janome lists built-in top cover stitch as a 3000 Professional feature.
Our spec lists no knife and Janome shows cutting width adjustment as not available, so it is a coverstitch and chain stitch machine, not a serger.
SCHMETZ ELx705. The manual says #80/12 is installed and the standard set is 2 x 80/12 and 3 x 90/14.
19 lb, confirmed on the Janome product page. Dimensions are not published for this model.

faqs.q: Does it have a free arm?
faqs.a: Yes. Janome lists a built-in free arm and describes an extra large bed space of 4 x 5.5 in, which is not a throat measurement.

faqs.q: Why do some owners report unravelling chain stitch?
faqs.a: One Reddit owner could not lock off in-the-round chain stitch, and a reply said it is less of a problem with two needles and a lighter knit. It is a single thread, not a pattern.

faqs.q: How strong is the owner evidence?
faqs.a: Thin: 8 voices, 4 first-hand, from Reddit threads. Many threads are help requests, so problems are over-represented and no theme reaches the recurring threshold.

faqs.q: What does Amazon's 4.5 from 67 ratings mean here?
faqs.a: That rating is shared by several listings, including the 1000CPX variations, so it is not a rating for the 2000CPX alone.
Janome lists an MSRP of $1,099 and says to see a dealer for pricing. Dealer prices are the dealer's own.
